A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work and contain readable scientific text, equations, figures, and Appendices A.1–A.12. v2 removes the concluding NeurIPS checklist, but the complete supplied material supports reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original MultiBERT probing, synthetic masked-language-model experiments, forgetting interventions, and supplementary embedding and generalization analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains the original probing, synthetic training, forgetting, and supplementary analysis results in Sections 2–6 and Appendices A.2–A.11.

M1.justification: Active forgetting still resets embeddings every k steps, while temporary forgetting restricts these resets to the first N training steps. The model architecture, training objectives, and procedures in Sections 4–5 and Appendix A.6 are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same Penn Treebank probing, English UD and OntoNotes syntactic tasks, synthetic noun/adjective task, and unseen-token and alternative embedding-distribution evaluations.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within corresponding experiments. Figure 8 retains the same vanilla training, increased weight decay, active forgetting, and temporary forgetting comparison.

E3.justification: Sampling rules, probe layers and checkpoints, accuracy metrics, synthetic vocabulary/skew/ambiguity settings, model configurations, and optimization settings remain unchanged in the main text and appendices.

E4.justification: The layerwise and pushdown analyses, weight-decay comparison, ambiguity and vocabulary sweeps, embedding analyses, and alternative random-distribution tests are retained unchanged in Appendices A.2–A.11.

E5.justification: Removing checklist item 7 deletes the explicit description of closed-form error-bar calculation and the explanation that synthetic error bars were omitted to avoid crowding Figure 3. Section 2 still specifies MultiBERT seeds 0, 1, and 2 and ±1 SEM; the plotted uncertainty is unchanged.

E6.justification: v2 removes the checklist-only qualitative observation that synthetic experiments exhibited very low variance across initializations. All plotted numerical results and the performance findings in the main text and scientific appendices are unchanged.

T1.justification: The probing formalization in Appendix A.1 and the probabilistic grammar and sampling formulation in Appendix A.5 are unchanged. No theorem, proof, or mathematical correction is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about structural ICL transience, preservation through active forgetting, and controllable coexistence of in-context and in-weights strategies through temporary forgetting.

C2.justification: Scientific interpretations and limitations remain unchanged, including embedding memorization, hyperparameter-tuning requirements, the absence of natural-language LM forgetting experiments, and the geometric generalization limits discussed in Appendix A.11.

D1.justification: Deleting checklist items 5 and 12 removes statements about academic dataset access and noncommercial LDC licensing. The code-release footnote and its target, implementation details, hyperparameters, and Appendix A.12 compute disclosure remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The research citations, bibliography, and Section 7 positioning relative to prior ICL and forgetting research are unchanged, including the claimed novelty of using forgetting to induce ICL.

P1.justification: v2 removes the peripheral NeurIPS checklist, updates the correspondence address and arXiv header, and corrects 'Ffter' to 'After' in Section 6. The scientific narrative, section order, and appendix organization otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–13 retain identical graphical content, captions, axes, legends, and placement. The retained page layouts are unchanged; the removed checklist contains no figures or tables.

improvement.justification: The scientific methods, evidence, and substantive limitations are unchanged. Although v2 corrects a typo and removes checklist boilerplate, it also loses the explanation for omitted synthetic error bars and dataset-access/licensing statements. These limited losses modestly reduce reporting transparency.
